title: contractFindings
responsibility: Compares documented inputs, defaults, errors and outputs against the existing source contract and recognises state descriptions without executing source.

inputs.name: contractFindings.unit
inputs.description: Stored unit identity, source ownership and authored contract selected for this review.

inputs.name: contractFindings.source
inputs.description: Unmerged contract derived by the existing source indexer, so authored omissions remain observable.

inputs.name: contractScopes.contract
inputs.description: Validated stored contract containing inputs, outputs, errors, callable operations and snippets.

inputs.name: documentsState.items
inputs.description: Documented contract fields whose names, types and descriptions may name a source state.

inputs.name: documentsState.state
inputs.description: Exact state or catalog slot to attribute; comparisons remain scoped to the selected entity.

outputs.name: contractFindings
outputs.description: Deduplicated missing requiredness, defaults, errors, outputs and source-input findings with entity and source or contract location.

outputs.name: contractScopes
outputs.description: Root contract followed by its operations, initializers and snippets without combining their input or error ownership.

outputs.name: documentsState
outputs.description: Whether field documentation explicitly names the state, including fail/failure as documented forms of failed.
